author: Cleo Abram
description:
These 722 new math papers claim to solve problems that have stumped the world’s best mathematicians and computers for decades.

To see if those answers are right, they used a well-known software that’s kind of like spell-check but for math logic. 

So far, the ones it’s checked look good, which is making mathematicians both very freaked out and very excited – because these problems COULD help them understand everything from patterns in prime numbers, why magnets are magnets, and how the stuff inside the Sun behaves… 

To see more, subscribe!

#openAI #math #problem #AI #computer
title: These 722 Papers Just Broke The Math World
